instructions: Copy the selected individual skill or host suite outside the repository into an isolated temporary project. Give an independent active host agent only the request and raw fixture described for that case, with the installed SKILL.md. Do not supply expected observations to the executing agent. Use native browser/tools and native agents as available; do not launch semantic model subprocesses. Evaluate actual questions, tool actions and resulting source/studio/specification/feedback evidence. Mark unexecuted scenarios not-run; do not treat routing or substring assertions as behavioral proof. No publishing, sharing, deployments or external messaging.

cases.request: Design the dispatch overview for our existing field-service app. Reuse the current brand and produce a clickable prototype. The dispatcher must assign a crew and confirm its availability.
cases.fixture: Provide a working app shell, tokens.css with a six-pixel spacing scale, two existing component examples and a short feature brief.
cases.expectedObservations: Inspects existing shell/components/tokens before generating; does not ask already-set source or format; reuses the project scale; ships one direction and all three views; browser-checks assignment and confirmation.

cases.request: Design an onboarding experience for the new app.
cases.fixture: No existing UI. Product notes mention both freelance photographers and agency coordinators as possible users, without deciding the primary audience.
cases.expectedObservations: Asks a consequential audience/journey question before committing screens; establishes local tokens, brand and component recipes once clarified; records inferred decisions; does not fabricate a confirmed audience.

cases.request: Make a mobile onboarding walkthrough for independent photographers; it should collect a profile and accept a first booking.
cases.fixture: No structured question tool is available. The brief is otherwise complete and the user has approved reversible assumptions.
cases.expectedObservations: Uses concise chat only if an unresolved decision matters; continues without a missing-question-tool blocker; honors mobile and walkthrough choices; creates editable source and specification.

cases.request: Use the supplied mockup as the reference for a responsive account page. Keep its typography and layout character.
cases.fixture: Provide one readable PNG mockup and the current account requirements, including password and save-error states.
cases.expectedObservations: Inspects the image; distinguishes observed versus approximated values; authors usable controls and states; creates all ten specification sections in this run rather than deferring PNG extraction to Plan.

cases.request: Show me three ways to present the dispatch workload. Keep the same crew-assignment task, then let me choose on a board.
cases.fixture: Provide the same product brief and two representative screens. Native agents are available, without any provider credentials or global CLI.
cases.expectedObservations: Generates three materially different directions in disjoint sources with one coordinating document author; boots a local comparison; preserves one failed variant visibly if generation is interrupted; awaits the user’s selection without inventing votes.

cases.request: Apply the pinned change to the primary action in dispatch step one. Keep the other screens as they are.
cases.fixture: Provide a rendered multi-screen design document, editable source, board arrangement, one targeted pin, a pin with a missing anchor and one unrelated pin.
cases.expectedObservations: Changes only the targeted source or disclosed shared component instances; preserves unrelated source bytes and IDs; leaves missing-anchor pin stale/unresolved; resolves only rendered and browser-checked feedback; synchronizes the specification and manifest.

cases.request: Design this nine-step field onboarding flow as a walkthrough with a desktop overview too.
cases.fixture: Provide nine explicit ordered steps and business rules, with one empty and one error state.
cases.expectedObservations: Preserves all nine steps, functional navigation through the final step, mobile and desktop frames, a canvas overview and the same content in Prototype; inspects the final step rather than testing only the first eight.

cases.request: Make the pinned button-label correction and prepare the handoff.
cases.fixture: Provide existing source, specification and one pin. Browser/screenshot tools are unavailable in this host.
cases.expectedObservations: Applies the scoped edit and static validation, returns usable source and preview as unverified, keeps the pin unresolved pending rendered inspection, and clearly names the missing browser check without fabricating evidence.
